Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to delete my opponent's Digimon without placing this card in digivolution cards?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may place up to 5 differently named Digimon cards with [Gammamon] in their names from your trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution cards. Then, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as much or less DP as this Digimon.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has 5 or more digivolution cards, it may attack without suspending.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When any of your opponent's Digimon are deleted, gain 1 memory.
